name: reader-inspector-phone
review: Reviewed old, new and diff images for the new standalone reader entry. Exactly 50 compared pixels differ, all raw differences confined to the play-symbol raster at x324-338/y111-128 in the 374x440 inspector crop. Button region and every surrounding pixel are unchanged; word, reading, meaning, Japanese reference and personal save actions remain legible and unclipped. Stable capture; zero automated a11y violations; symbolic-button contrast reviewed visually. The exact fallback-font/rasterization cause is not established. Accept this one independently reviewed initial-reader capture, preserve the 20-pixel threshold and regression canaries, and require a fresh full CI run. Synthetic-font evidence only; not production-font/device approval.
